title: Compact provenance event format for cross-domain admin changes
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Goal: Define a compact, searchable, and privacy-conscious event envelope and change-delta format that captures admin and RBAC v2 operations across hosted/dedicated/private deployments and links SSO/SAML identity context. The format must: 1) reliably record actor and target identities and confidence, 2) represent granular diffs for authorization objects (roles, policies, bindings, grants, service principals), 3) be small (typical <1KB), 4) support redaction rules for PII, 5) be indexable for audit queries and incident forensic workflows, and 6) be compatible with streaming storage (JSONL/Avro) and direct query (Elastic/ClickHouse) ingestion.

Proposed envelope fields (canonical names, see acceptance criteria for final contract): event_id, timestamp_utc, event_type, service, tenant_id, actor_id, actor_type, actor_identity_source, actor_identity_confidence, sso_assertion_id, saml_idp, session_index, target_id, target_type, resource_path, change_delta_compact, human_summary, intent, request_context, ip_address_hash, user_agent_hash, causal_parent_id, causality_root_id, retention_tier, redaction_tags, signature_meta. The change_delta_compact is an array of short op records: "op|path|before|after" where before/after are compact tokens (or hashes) for large blobs. Example compact delta string: "SET|/roles/role-123/permissions|rw-user:create,read|rw-user:create,read,delete".

SSO/SAML linking: attach saml assertion metadata when available (saml_idp, subject_nameid, role_claims, assertion_timestamp, session_index) and always capture an actor_identity_source (sso|oauth|internal|api-key). Identity confidence is a small enum: high|medium|low and used for risk scoring.

Privacy and redaction: field-level redaction tags are applied at write-time (pii/email, token, secret). Storage policy: sensitive fields are stored encrypted at rest and sampled (full vs. summary) based on retention_tier. Retention tiers: ephemeral-7d, standard-90d, compliance-7y.

Indexing and query keys: index on (tenant_id, event_type, actor_id, target_id, timestamp_utc). Provide a lightweight secondary index for assertion/session lookups (sso_assertion_id -> event_id).

Operational constraints: must support up to 15K admin events/min across multi-region ingestion with 99.9% write availability. Target median envelope size <1KB and 95th <4KB. Compression and delta-hashing allowed to reduce storage.

Compatibility & migration: design a shim to convert existing audit event shapes into the compact envelope during ingestion (mapper lambda). Provide a bypass mode for legacy consumers.

Deliverables: 1) full schema doc and example event set, 2) write-path implementation (server-side encoder), 3) ingestion mapping for existing logs, 4) query adapters for console and incident tooling, 5) compliance retention runner and redaction pipeline, 6) unit + load tests, 7) security review sign-off.

Acceptance criteria: a) schema reviewed and approved by Security and Compliance, b) end-to-end ingestion + query demo with sample RBAC changes and SSO link, c) size/throughput goals met in load test, d) migration plan for historical logs approved.
comments: 2025-02-11 - Initial scoping with Security (Aisha, Priya). Agreed on compact op encoding and per-field redaction tags.
2025-02-18 - Design sync: decided to use a simple pipe-delimited compact op format for readability and to avoid large nested diffs; store expensive blobs as hashed references.
2025-02-25 - PM feedback (Liam Carter): ensure console rollups can map compact deltas back to human-readable summaries for audit UI. Add human_summary field requirement.
2025-02-28 - Security review requested: primary concerns are SSO attribution correctness, replay protection, and encryption-in-transit/endpoints. Added signature_meta to envelope.
2025-03-03 - Proto schema posted to Confluence (link below); awaiting eng review and load-test plan. Jonah to open PR for encoder.
2025-03-05 - Jonah Reed: started implementation branch, added unit tests for compact op parser and SSO linkage extraction (GH PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/5123).
